acceptanceCriteria: TestLocalOutcomeTracePathLimitKeepsAdmissionReason passes with TMPDIR under a symlinked ancestor (macOS /var/folders, or a /tmp-based TMPDIR).
go test ./internal/dogfoodflow passes with TMPDIR=/tmp/<dir> on macOS.
The macOS nightly job no longer fails on this test.
body: Nightly macOS failed TestLocalOutcomeTracePathLimitKeepsAdmissionReason (internal/dogfoodflow/change_test.go). The test used t.TempDir() directly as the evidence root. recordWithClosedStages publishes the aggregate through aggregateReadFile, which starts with dogfoodoperation.CheckParents and refuses any symlinked ancestor; macOS TMPDIR (/var -> /private/var) has one, so localOutcome returned aggregate-publication-failed instead of the admission reason. Reproduce: TMPDIR=/tmp/x go test -run TestLocalOutcomeTracePathLimitKeepsAdmissionReason ./internal/dogfoodflow (macOS). Expected: pass; actual: aggregate-publication-failed. Product behavior is correct (refusing symlinked ancestors is intended); the test fixture is wrong. Fix: resolve the temp root with filepath.EvalSymlinks, as aggregate_worker_test.go already does.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#802 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/802), merged to main at 3b123d3def8235de2be793e2d6e9a386c3eab854. The test resolves its temp root with filepath.EvalSymlinks; go test ./internal/dogfoodflow with a symlinked TMPDIR failed only this test before and passes after (macOS). Nightly run 38140828076 failed only this test. Codex review PASS; dogfood check and seal PASS. Next macOS nightly green NOT_OBSERVED yet. Evidence: sha256 of the build log at the merge commit.

title: Nightly macOS: dogfoodflow trace-path-limit test fails under symlinked TMPDIR
